stem: In what way does the audience in the poem “Assembly” DIFFER from the audience dog in the selection “Public Speaking Is Easier When a Cute Dog Is Listening”?
instruction: Use “Public Speaking Is Easier When a Cute Dog Is Listening” and “Assembly” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: Only the audience in the poem encourages students to prepare for the performance.

options.label: B
options.text: Only the audience in the poem listens during the performance.

options.label: C
options.text: Only the audience in the poem is given a reward for listening to the performance.

options.label: D
options.text: Only the audience in the poem shows disruptive behavior before the performance begins.
